player_prompt.intro:
Yin a kɔɔc Sokoban. Yin ee kɔɔc, ku yin a miɛl lɔɔk aɣɔɔk yiic.
        Yin a neɛk ɣɔɔn a lɔɔk, yin a kɔɔc aɣɔɔn a lɔɔk a neɛk.
        Yin a kɔɔc aɣɔɔn a lɔɔk a neɛk a dɔɔl, ku yin a kɔɔc aɣɔɔn a lɔɔk a pɛɛl.
        Aɣɔɔn a lɔɔk, kɛɛc a neɛk a:
        - Kɔɔc (yin) a neɛk 'P' 
        - Dɔɔl a neɛk '#' 
        - Aɣɔɔk a neɛk 'X' 
        - Ɛɛl a neɛk 'O'
        - Aɣɔɔk a neɛk '√' a ɛɛl
        Yin a kɔɔc aɣɔɔn [w] a neɛk a dɛɛl, [a] a neɛk a cɛɛl, [s] a neɛk a pɛɛl, ku [d] a neɛk a neɛk.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wäär lɛ̈k aya cɔl kuɔny ë̈ thïn. Lɛ̈k [up], [down], [left], [right] kɛn [w], [a], [s], [d].
